{{Top|leg}}
The '''Base Operations Center''' was a fortified bunker in the heart of [[Vergesso Prime/Legends|Vergesso Prime]], forming the lowest part of the [[Vergesso Base]], connected to the rest of the facility by [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''
</ref>

It was the command and control for Vergesso Base, overseen by [[Ororo Transportation/Legends|Ororo Transportation's]] [[Nim Zanti]]. [[Vergesso Control]] operated from Base Ops. In the middle was the Spaceport Control / Defense Command, surrounded by the station's Environmental Control / Power Distribution, detention center, and corporate offices.<ref name="guide" />

[[Natori Association]] provided security in the form of a full [[platoon/Legends|platoon]] permanently present there.<ref name="guide" />

During the [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards]], the bunker withstood the destruction, even though the turbolifts were blocked by debris and [[Life support/Legends|life support]] malfunctioned. Beings who happened to be there at that time (technicians, Natori mercenaries, detainees and others) were among the survivors. Under the leadership of [[Nim Zanti]] and [[Vam Margan]], they found supplies and unblocked the turbolift tubes from debris in order to reach [[the Life]] level.<ref name="lights">{{WEGCite|story=Will the Last Person Leaving Vergesso Turn Off the Lights?|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

Within a few months after the assault, the Center was able to be repaired and function again, before eventually the base passed to other hands.<ref name="guide" />
